### Webhook Rutas

`PATCH`

Este Webhook se puede enviar para eventos solicitados por el cliente.

A diferencia del método POST, que se utiliza principalmente para crear un nuevo recurso enviando toda la información necesaria, el método PATCH está diseñado para actualizar parcialmente un recurso existente.

Con PATCH solo se envían los campos que necesitan modificarse, sin reemplazar el contenido completo del recurso.Esto lo hace ideal para operaciones de edición puntual, mientras que POST se reserva para la creación de datos nuevos.

Si necesitan configurar este servicio, por favor ponerse en contacto con soporte@driv.in para que les solicitemos la información necesaria (endpoint y autenticación)

| Campos | Tipo | Tamaño | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| vehicle | string | 255 | Codigo del Vehiculo |
| vehicle_detail | string | 255 | Detalles del Vehiculo |
| route_id | integer | 11 | Id de la ruta |
| route_code | string | 255 | Codigo de la ruta |
| description | string | 255 | Descripcion del vehiculo |
| deploy_date | string | 255 | Fecha de inicio de la ruta |
| supplier_code | string | 255 | Codigo del proveedor |
| scenario_token | string | 255 | Token del plan |
| schema_code | string | 255 | Codigo del esquema utilizado |
| schema_name | string | 255 | Nombre del esquema utilizado |
| approved_at | string | 255 | Fecha de aprobacion de ruta |
| platform | string | 255 | Campo Personalizado, indica de que plataforma del deposito sale el vehiculo |
| started_at | string | 255 | Fecha donde se inicio la ruta |
| fleet_sequence | string | 255 | Informacion de secuencia de rutas |
| login_url | string | 255 | Url de login para utilizar algo en especifico |
| tags | json [] |   | Caracteristicas del vehiculo, los pedidos deben de tener los mismos tags |
| driver | json |   | Informacion del conductor |
| driver.email | string | 255 | Email del conductor |
| driver.full_name | string | 255 | Nombre del conductor |
| driver.phone | string | 255 | Telefono del conductor |
| summary | json |   | Informacion de la ruta |
| summary.total_trips | number |   | Total de viajes |
| summary.total_orders | number |   | Total de pedidos |
| summary.total_addresses | number |   | Total de direcciones |
| summary.total_distance | number |   | Total de distancia a recorrer |
| summary.total_time | number |   | Total de tiempo |
| trips | json [] |   | Conjunto de informacion de cada viaje |
| trips[0...].results[0...].deposit | boolean |   | Hace referencia a si sale o regresa al deposito |
| trips[0...].results[0...].position | number |   | Posicion en el viaje |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta_mode | number |   | Selecciona la forma de escribir el eta en la ruta completa |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta | string | 255 | Hora estimaga de llegada (se modifica despues de cada entrega) |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta_approved | string | 255 | Tiempo en la cual el conductor aprueba la ruta, se recalcula el eta |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta_started | string | 255 | Tiempo en la cual el conductor inicia la ruta, se recalcula el eta |
| stop | json |   | Informacion del lugar de detencion |
| stop.code | string | 255 | Codigo de la direccion |
| stop.name | string | 255 | Nombre de la direccion |
| stop.client | string | 255 | Nombre del cliente |
| stop.address_type | string | 255 | Tipo de direccion |
| stop.address | string | 255 | Direccion |
| stop.reference | string | 255 | Referencia de la direccion |
| stop.city | string | 255 | Ciudad de la direccion |
| stop.country | string | 255 | Pais de la direccion |
| stop.lat | number |   | Latitud de la direccion |
| stop.lng | number |   | Longitud de la direccion |
| stop.postal_code | string | 255 | Codigo postal de la direccion |
| stop.service_time | string | 255 | tiempo de servicio |
| stop.priority | number |   | Prioridad de la visita (Ej: Prioridad 2, 3 o 4, donde 2 es más prioritario que 3 y 4) |
| stop.skills | json |   | Características de la dirección |
| stop.time_windows | json [] |   | Arreglo de ventanas horarias para que se realice la visita |
| stop.time_windows[0].start | string | 255 | Hora de inicio de ventana horaria "hh:mm" |
| stop.time_windows[0].end | string | 255 | Hora de fin de ventana horaria "hh:mm" |
| orders | json [] |   | Conjunto de pedidos |
| orders[0].idx | string | 255 | Indice de la entrega dependiente de ruta primaria |
| orders[0...].code | string | 255 | Codigo de el pedido |
| orders[0...].delivery_date | string | 255 | Fecha de entrega |
| orders[0...].supplier_code | string | 255 | Codigo del proveedor |
| orders[0...].supplier_name | string | 255 | Nombre del proveedor |
| orders[0...].client_code | string | 255 | Codigo del cliente |
| orders[0...].client_name | string | 255 | Nombre del cliente |
| orders[0...].contact_name | string | 255 | Nombre de contacto |
| orders[0...].contact_phone | string | 255 | Telefono de contacto |
| orders[0..].contact_email | string | 255 | Email de contacto |
| orders[0...].units | number |   | Cantidad de unidades |
| orders[0...].units_1 | number |   | Unidad de medida Ej: Kg |
| orders[0...].units_2 | number |   | Unidad de medida 2 Ej: M3 |
| orders[0...].units_3 | number |   | Unidad de medida 3 Ej: Bandejas o Pallets |
| orders[0...].(custom_1-custom_11) | string | 255 | Campo personalizado para alguna descripcion |
| orders[0...].(number_1-number_4) | string | 255 | Campo personalizado para algun valor requerido |
| items | json [] |   | Conjunto de items o articulos de el pedido |
| pickups | json [] |   | Conjunto de pedidos a retirar |

**Example Request**

structure example

```bash
curl --location --request PATCH '' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data ''
```

GPS
Con nuestra API positions podrás enviar los datos de tus propios GPS con el fin de poder obtener información en tiempo real aún mas precisa.

Si bien nosotros ya manejamos la información de la posición del vehículo con nuestra aplicación móvil, esta API te puede servir que podamos recibir datos extra como la temperatura, el control de apertura de puertas, etc!

## Costos

### Receive

```http
POST https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/trips/receive
```

**Headers**

- `x-api-key`: {{api_key}}
- `content-type`: application/json

**Body**

raw (json)

```json
{
    "trip_code": "11",
    "orders": [
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C7",
            "load_status": "received"
        }, 
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C6",
            "load_status": "missing"
        }
    ]
}
```

**Example Request**

Receive

```bash
curl --location 'https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/trips/receive' \
--header 'x-api-key: {{api_key}}' \
--header 'content-type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "trip_code": "11",
    "orders": [
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C7",
            "load_status": "received"
        }, 
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C6",
            "load_status": "missing"
        }
    ]
}'
```

**Example Response**

**Body**

No response body
This request doesn't return any response body

## Citas

### Webhook Eventos

`POST`

endpoint to send webhook
Este Webhook se activara ao momento de reaizar um evento.

Si necessitam configurar este serviço, por favor ponerse em contato com soporte@driv.in para que les solicitemos a informação necesaria (endpoint e autenticación)

| Campos | Tipo | Tamanho | Descrição |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| lat | number |   | Latitude onde ocurrio o evento |
| lng | number |   | Longitude onde ocurrio o evento |
| datetime | string | 255 | Data e hora do evento |
| vehicle_code | string | 255 | Código do veículo |
| route_id | number |   | Identificador da rota |
| route_id | string | 255 | Código da rota |
| deploy_date | string | 255 | Data de carga da rota |
| supplier_code | string | 255 | Código do Proveedor |
| event_type_name | string | 255 | Tipo de evento o cual disparo o webhook, este tem que ser previamente solicitado para configurar o serviço para este tipo de evento |
| event_type_code | string | 255 | Código do tipo de evento |
| trip_number | json [] |   | Numero de viagem |
| driver | json |   | Informacion do motorista |
| driver.email | string | 255 | Email do motorista |
| driver.full_name | string | 255 | Nome do motorista |
| driver.phone | string | 255 | Telefone do motorista |
| user | json |   | Informacion do usuário |
| orders | json[] |   | Informacion do pedido na cual ocurrio o evento |
| address_code | string | 255 | Código da direccion onde se origino o evento |

**Example Request**

structure example

```bash
curl --location 'structure example'
```

_200 OK_

Labels
Método permite generar etiquetas a partir de los códigos de ordenes enviados en el json. La api devuelve el PDF con las etiquetas de las ordenes indicadas.

### Labels

```http
POST https://external-qa.driv.in/api/external/v2/labels
```

| Campos | Tipo | Tamanho | Descrição |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| orders[] | json []- String | 255 | Conjunto de pedidos |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Body (raw)**

```json
{
    "orders": [
        "int0001",
        "int0002"
    ]
}
```

**Example Request**

Ejemplo

```bash
curl --location 'https://external-qa.driv.in/api/external/v2/labels' \
--header 'X-API-Key: {{api_key}}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "orders": [
        "int0001",
        "int0002"
    ]
}'
```

_201 Created_

**Example Response**

**Body**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": "OK"
}
```

### Address

```http
GET https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/addresses
```

Gets an address from the Address Master.

Description of the fields obtained:

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | 255 | Código de la dirección |
| name | string | 255 | Address name |
| client | string | 255 | Customer name |
| address_type | string | 255 | Address type. Field used to segment customers for reports |
| address1 | string | 255 | Physical address, e.g., street and number (this field is used for georeferencing so it should be as clean as possible) |
| address2 | string | 255 | Reference to add to the address (Office, Apartment, etc.) |
| city | string | 255 | Municipality or City of the address (depends on the country) |
| state | string | 255 | Region or State of the address (depends on the country) |
| country | string | 255 | Address country |
| zip_code | string | 255 | Address postal code |
| phone | string | 255 | Teléfono de la persona de contacto |
| email | string | 255 | Contact person email |
| lat | number |   | Latitud de la dirección |
| lng | number |   | Longitud de la dirección |
| georeferenced | boolean |   | Hace referencia a si la direccion esta Georeferenciada por google maps |
| service_time | number |   | Tiempo de servicio |
| time_window_start | string | 255 | Hora de inicio de la ventana horaria |
| time_window_end | string | 255 | Hora de inicio de la ventana horaria |
| dispatch_date | string | 255 | Fecha de envio |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `api key`

**Params**

- `created_at`: Fecha de creación
- `updated_at`: Fecha de actualización
- `georeferenced`: 0 o 1
- `page`: Nro de página (1000 direcciones por página)
- `code[]`: Arreglo de códigos a buscar
- `dispatch_date`: Fecha de despacho
- `client[]`: Nombre cliente
- `address_type[]`: Tipo de dirección

**Example Request**

_200 OK_

```bash
curl --location 'https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/addresses' \
--header 'X-API-Key: {{api_key}}'
```

_200 OK_

**Example Response**

**Body**

## Orders

### Create Multi-Day Scenario

```http
POST https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/scenarios
```

Creates a multi-day scenario with the parameters provided in the "body".

Where the start date is the "date" of the created scenario, and the plan end date is the last delivered order, that is el "delivery_date" con la fecha mas lejana.

IMPORTANTE : El schema tiene que estar configurado para multiples dias.

Description of the fields sent in the body:

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| description | stringrequired | 255 | Scenario name. |
| date | stringrequired | 255 | Scenario date in format "yyyy-mm-dd". |
| fleet_name | string | 255 | Vehicle fleet name to use in the scenario (If there is no fleet_name or vehicles, ALL vehicles from the vehicle master are associated with the scenario.) |

schema_name

| stringrequired (if schema_code: null) | 255 | Schema name que le asignaremos al scenario. |   |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| schema_code | stringrequired (if schema_name: null) | 255 | Código del esquema que le asignaremos al scenario. |
| clients[] | json [] |   | Array containing the customer information to visit, can be several. |
| clients[0...].code | string | 255 | Code that identifies the address or customer. |
| clients[0...].address | stringrequired | 255 | Address (not required if the code already exists in the address master). |
| clients[0...].reference | string | 255 | Address reference |
| clients[0...].city | string | 255 | Municipality or City (depends on the country. |
| clients[0...].country | stringrequired | 255 | Country (not required if the code already exists in the address master) |
| clients[0...].county | string | 255 | Region or Province (depends on the country). |
| clients[0...].lat | decimal | 12, 9 | Address latitude |
| clients[0...].lng | decimal | 12, 9 | Address longitude |
| clients[0...].postal_code | string | 255 | Address postal code |
| clients[0...].name | string | 255 | Address name |
| clients[0...].client_name | string | 255 | Customer name |
| clients[0...].client_code | string | 255 | Customer code |
| clients[0...].address_type | string | 255 | Address type |
| clients[0...].contact_name | string | 255 | Delivery contact name |
| clients[0...].contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone de entrega |
| clients[0...].contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email de entrega |
| clients[0...].approve_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when approving the route |
| clients[0...].approve_contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone to notify when approving the route |
| clients[0...].approve_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when approving the route |
| clients[0...].start_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when starting the route |
| clients[0...].start_contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone to notify when starting the route |
| clients[0...].start_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when starting the route |
| clients[0...].near_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when the vehicle is about to arrive |
| clients[0...].near_contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone to notify when the vehicle is about to arrive |
| clients[0...].near_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when the vehicle is about to arrive |
| clients[0...].delivered_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when the delivery/pickup is finished |
| clients[0...].delivered_contact_phone | string | 255 | Telefono del contacto a notificar al finalizar la entrega/retiro |
| clients[0...].delivered_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when the delivery/pickup is finished |
| clients[0...].service_time | number | 11 | Tiempo de servicio |
| clients[0...].priority | integer | 11 | Priority for the visit to be planned for this scenario in case of lack of vehicles |
| time_windows[] | json [] |   | Array of time windows for the visit to take place |
| time_windows[0].start | string |   | Time window start time "hh:mm" |
| time_windows[0].end | string |   | Time window end time "hh:mm" |
| tags[] | json [] | 255 | Address characteristics that the assigned vehicle must meet |
| orders[] | json [] |   | Set of orders. |
| orders[0...].code | stringrequired | 255 | Order code. |
| orders[0...].alt_code | string | 255 | Alternative order code. |
| orders[0...].description | string | 255 | Order description. |
| orders[0...].units_1 | number | 32, 10 | Unit of measure 1. |
| orders[0...].units_2 | number | 32, 10 | Unit of measure 2. |
| orders[0...].units_3 | number | 32, 10 | Unit of measure 3. |
| orders[0...].position | number | 11 | Order position within the route. |
| orders[0...].vehicle_code | string | 255 | Previously assigned vehicle code. |
| orders[0...].delivery_date | string |   | Maximum delivery date for the order. |
| orders[0...].billing_date | string |   | Fecha de venta de la orden. |
| orders[0...].cusom_1 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: invoice type |
| orders[0...].cusom_2 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: payment condition |
| orders[0...].cusom_3 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: planned monetary value |
| orders[0...].(custom_6 - custom_20) | string | 255 | campo auxiliar de información de la orden. |
| orders[0...].(number_1 - number_10) | number |   | campo auxiliar de información de la orden |
| orders[0...].suppler_code | string | 255 | Supplier code |
| items[] | json [] |   | Set of order items |
| items[0...].code | string | 255 | Item code (SKU) |
| items[0...].description | string | 255 | Item description |
| units | number |   | Item unit quantity |
| items[0...].units_1 | number |   | Unit of measure 1 ej:Kg (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| items[0...].units_2 | number |   | Unit of measure 2 ej:KM3 (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| items[0...].units_3 | number |   | Unit of measure 3 ej:bandejas o palets (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |

Response

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| scenario_token | string | 255 | Token del scenario recientemente creado |
| addresses_count | number |   | Numero de direcciones registradas en el scenario para visitar |
| orders_count | number |   | Numero de ordenes registradas en el scenario |
| items_count | number |   | Numero de items registradas en el scenario |
| vehicles_count | number |   | Numero de vehiculos asignados en el scenario |
| added | array |   | Indica el codigo de las ordenes creadas |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Body (raw)**


### Create Multiple Scenarios

```http
POST https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/multipleleg
```

Creates a scenario whose orders have multiple legs. The following table describes the requested parameters and an example is shown below.

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| clients[] | jsonrequired |   | Array containing the information of customers to visit |
| code | string | 255 | Code that identifies the address or customer |
| address | stringrequired | 255 | Address (not required if the code already exists in the address master) |
| reference | string | 255 | Address reference |
| city | string | 255 | Municipality or City (depends on the country |
| county | string | 255 | Region or Province (depends on the country) |
| country | stringrequired | 255 | Country (not required if the code already exists in the address master) |
| lat | number | 12, 9 | Latitud |
| lng | number | 12, 9 | Longitud |
| postal_code | string | 255 | Postal code |
| name | string | 255 | Address name |
| client_name | string | 255 | Customer name |
| client_code | string | 255 | Customer code |
| address_type | string | 255 | Address type |
| orders[] | json |   | Set of orders |
| orders[0...].code | stringrequired | 255 | Order code |
| orders[0...].alt_code | string | 255 | Alternative order code |
| orders[0...].description | string | 255 | Order description |
| orders[0...].units_1 | number |   | Unit of measure 1 |
| orders[0...].units_2 | number |   | Unit of measure 2 |
| orders[0...].units_3 | number |   | Unit of measure 3 |
| orders[0...].position | number |   | Order delivery position |
| orders[0...].vehicle_code | string | 255 | Vehicle code assigned to the order |
| orders[0...].delivery_date | string | 255 | Maximum delivery date for the order |
| orders[0...].billing_date | string | 255 | Order billing date |
| orders[0...].order_type | string | 255 | Order type |
| orders[0...].(custom_1-custom_11) | string | 255 | Field for additional information de la orden |
| orders[0...].number_1 | number |   | Field for additional information de la orden |
| items[] | json |   | Set of order items |
| items[0...].code | string | 255 | Item code (SKU) |
| items[0...].description | string | 255 | Item description |
| items[0...].units | number | 11 | Item unit quantity |
| items[0...].units_1 | number | 30, 12 | Unit of measure 1 (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| items[0...].units_2 | number | 30, 12 | Unit of measure 2 (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| items[0...].units_3 | number | 30, 12 | Unit of measure 3 (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| legs[] | json |   | Set of order legs |
| legs[0...].schema_name | stringrequired | 255 | Schema associated with the leg (this defines the origin of the leg) |
| legs[0...].address_code | stringrequired | 255 | Destination address code for this leg (must be defined in the customer master) |
| legs[0...].departure_date | string | 255 | Fecha de salida de este tramo (Es requerido sólo si este tramo es el primer tramo) |
| legs[0...].service_time | number | 11 | Tiempo de servicio |
| legs[0...].vehicle_code | string | 255 | Previously assigned vehicle |
| legs[0...].position | number | 11 | Order position within the route. |
| legs[0...].priority | number | 11 | Priority for the visit to be planned for this scenario in case of lack of vehicles |
| legs[0...].delivery_priority | number | 11 | Priority de que la visita sea entregada primero dentro de la ruta de un vehículo |
| legs[0...].contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name |
| legs[0...].contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone |
| legs[0...].contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email |
| legs[0...].approve_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when approving the route |
| legs[0...].approve_contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone to notify when approving the route |
| legs[0...].approve_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when approving the route |
| legs[0...].start_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when starting the route |
| legs[0...].start_contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone to notify when starting the route |
| legs[0...].start_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when starting the route |
| legs[0...].near_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when the vehicle is about to arrive |
| legs[0...].near_contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone to notify when the vehicle is about to arrive |
| legs[0...].near_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when the vehicle is about to arrive |
| legs[0...].delivered_contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name to notify when the delivery/pickup is finished |
| legs[0...].delivered_contact_phone | string | 255 | Telefono del contacto a notificar al finalizar la entrega/retiro |
| legs[0...].delivered_contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email to notify when the delivery/pickup is finished |
| tags[] | json |   | Address characteristics that the assigned vehicle must meet |
| time_windows[] | json |   | Array of time windows for the visit to take place |
| time_windows.start | time |   | Time window start time "hh:mm" |
| time_windows.end | time |   | Time window end time "hh:mm" |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Body (raw)**

### Proof of Delivery V3

```http
GET https://external.driv.in/api/external/v3/pods?start_date=2025-05-08&end_date=2025-05-09&order_code=&limit=10000&page=1
```

Version 3 del API pruebas de entrega (POD) que tiene datos de parametrización adicional, diseñada para soportar paginación y volumenes de PDE altos.

Available filters:

start_date (obligatorio)

end_date (obligatorio)

order_code (obligatorio)

limit

page

address_code

order_status

vehicle_code

folio

Importante:

Si se desea filtrar por fecha, es obligatorio incluir tanto start_date como end_date.

En caso de no utilizar el filtro de fechas, es obligatorio especificar el filtro order_code.

The maximum query range is 7 days.

A continuacion la descripcion de los datos obtenidos:

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | string | 255 | código de orden |
| type | string | 255 | tipo |
| code | string | 255 | Order code |
| alt_code | string | 255 | Alternative order code |
| description | string | 255 | Scenario or plan name |
| custom_1 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: planned monetary value |
| custom_4 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: actual monetary value |
| custom_5 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: indicates if there was a change in payment methods |
| custom_6 | string | 255 | Custom field for description |
| number_1 | string | 255 | Custom field for required value |
| number_2 | string | 255 | Custom field for required value |
| number_3 | string | 255 | Custom field for required value |
| is_otd | string | 255 | Hace referencia si se entregó en la ventana horaria |
| lat | float | - | Latitud de la dirección |
| lng | float | - | Longitud de la dirección |
| address_type | string | 255 | Address type |
| pod_arrival | string | 255 | Delivery proof arrival |
| near_pod | string | 255 | Near delivery proof |
| min_delivery_date | string | 255 | Delivery date mínima de la orden |
| status | string | 255 | Order status |
| status_code | string | 255 | Status code |
| load_status | string | 255 | Order load status |
| reason | string | 255 | Motivo o razón de la entrega |
| reason_code | string | 255 | Reason code o razón |
| otif | string | 255 | Indica si está aprobado y si se entregó dentro de la ventana horaria |
| delivered_by | string | 255 | Delivery driver email |
| supplier_code | string | 255 | Supplier code |
| supplier_name | string | 255 | Nombre del proveedor |
| client_code | string | 255 | Customer code |
| client_name | string | 255 | Customer name |
| pdf_pod_order | string | 255 | Delivery proof PDF document |
| contact_name | string | 255 | Nombre del contacto receptor |
| contact_email | string | 255 | Recipient contact email |
| contact_phone | string | 255 | Teléfono del contacto receptor |
| organization_name | string | 255 | Nombre de la organización |
| organization_alt_name | string | 255 | Nombre alternativo de la organización |
| planned_service_time | number | - | Planned service time |
| eta | string | 255 | Hora estimada de llegada |
| eta_approved | string | 255 | Tiempo en el cual el conductor aprueba la ruta |
| eta_started | string | 255 | Tiempo en el cual el conductor inicia la ruta |
| position | number | - | Posición de entrega |
| start_position | number | - | Posición al iniciar |
| delivery_position | number | - | Posición al entregar |
| distance | number | - | Distance traveled |
| odometer | number | - | Odómetro |
| tracked_arrival | string | 255 | Fecha/hora en que se detecta la llegada del vehículo |
| tracked_leave | string | 255 | Fecha/hora en que se detecta la salida del vehículo |
| tracked_service_time | number | - | Service time detectado |
| rating_1 | string | 255 | Survey sent to the customer |
| rating_2 | string | 255 | Survey sent to the customer |
| rating_3 | string | 255 | Survey sent to the customer |
| customer_comment | string | 255 | Customer comment |
| visit_arrival | string | 255 | Visit arrival |
| visit_leave | string | 255 | Visit departure |
| signature | string | 255 | Signatures recorded from the app |
| planned_date | string | 255 | Delivery day |
| scenario_token | string | 255 | Scenario or plan token |
| fleet_name | string | 255 | Fleet name |
| schema_code | string | 255 | Código del esquema |
| schema_name | string | 255 | Schema name |
| address_name | string | 255 | Address name |
| address_code | string | 255 | Código de la dirección |
| address_1 | string | 255 | Delivery address |
| address_2 | string | 255 | Punto de referencia |
| area_level_3 | string | 255 | Ciudad |
| area_level_2 | string | 255 | Región/Provincia |
| area_level_1 | string | 255 | State/Region |
| postal_code | string | 255 | Postal code |
| country | string | 255 | País |
| address_customer_name | string | 255 | Customer name |
| vehicle_code | string | 255 | Vehicle code |
| route_code | string | 255 | Route code |
| route_is_approved | boolean | - | Route approved |
| route_is_started | boolean | - | Route started |
| route_is_finished | boolean | - | Route finished |
| vehicle_description | string | 255 | Descripción del vehículo |
| route_approved_at | string | 255 | Fecha/Route approval time |
| route_started_at | string | 255 | Fecha/Route start time |
| route_finished_at | string | 255 | Fecha/Route finish time |
| driver_name | string | 255 | Driver name |
| driver_email | string | 255 | Driver email |
| driver_dni | string | 255 | Driver ID number |
| driver_license_number | string | 255 | Driver license |
| assistant_1_name | string | 255 | Nombre del asistente |
| assistant_1_email | string | 255 | Assistant email |
| route_comment | string | 255 | Route comment |
| employer_code | string | 255 | Billing code |
| employer_name | string | 255 | Nombre de facturación |
| trip_number | string | 255 | Número de viaje |
| trip_code | string | 255 | Trip code |
| trip_custom_1 | string | 255 | Trip custom field |
| odometer_start | number | - | Odómetro al iniciar |
| odometer_end | number | - | Odómetro al finalizar |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Params**

- `start_date`: 2025-05-08
- `Fecha de inicio 'required'`: end_date
- `2025-05-09`: Fecha de fin 'required'
- `order_code`: Código de la orden 'required'
- `limit`: 10000
- `Paginación (si no se indica, por defecto mostrará la pagina 1)`: page
- `1`: Límite de POD por página (se recomienda un máximo de 10.000 registros por página. Configurar un valor mayor podría ocasionar tiempos de respuesta más largos)
- `address_code`: true
- `código de dirección`: order_status
- `Estado de la orden (pending/approved/partial/rejected) required`: vehicle_code
- `Código de vehículo`: folio
- `Folio`: all_routes
- `true`: parametro para obtener todos los campos custom de cada orden

**Example Request**

_200 OK_

```bash
curl --location 'https://external.driv.in/api/external/v3/pods?start_date=2025-05-08&end_date=2025-05-08&limit=10000&page=1' \
--header 'X-API-Key: {{api_key}}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

_200 OK_

**Example Response**

### Resend Delivery Information

```http
PUT https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/orders/resend
```

Method for resending information to customer web services.

This method only works for customers that have the endpoint configured for resending proof of delivery data.

En el caso que el token no sea enviado, se buscará el código en todos los planes y se reenviará la información para cada uno de esos elementos.

Este servicio responde luego de que todas las ordenes ingresadas fueron reenviadas, por lo que se recomienda enviar grupos de ordenes acotados para no entrar en timeout de conexión.

The supported parameters are:

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | arrayrequired | 255 | Array of order codes. |
| token | string | 255 | Token del plan. |

Los errores posibles son:

| Error | Descripción |
| --- | --- |
| not_found | El código enviado no existe |
| not_assigned | El código no está asignado a alguna ruta |
| route_not_approved | El código está en una ruta no aprobada |
| route_not_started | El código está en una ruta no iniciada |
| not_closed | El código no ha sido cerrado |
| pending | El código se encuetra pendiente |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Body (raw)**

```json
{
	"code": ["28819647","1",2,3,4,"28819647"],
	"token": "AAAAAAAA-BBBB-CCCC-DDDD-FFFFFFFF"
}
```

**Example Request**

_200 OK_


## Webhook Structure

### Webhook Routes

`POST`

endpoint to send webhook
This Webhook can be sent for events requested by the customer.

If you need to configure this service, please contact soporte@driv.in para que les solicitemos la información necesaria (endpoint y autenticación)

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| vehicle | string | 255 | Vehicle code |
| vehicle_detail | string | 255 | Vehicle details |
| route_id | integer | 11 | Id de la ruta |
| route_code | string | 255 | Route code |
| description | string | 255 | Vehicle description |
| deploy_date | string | 255 | Fecha de inicio de la ruta |
| supplier_code | string | 255 | Supplier code |
| scenario_token | string | 255 | Scenario token |
| schema_code | string | 255 | Schema code used |
| schema_name | string | 255 | Schema name utilizado |
| approved_at | string | 255 | Fecha de aprobacion de ruta |
| platform | string | 255 | Custom field, indicates which depot platform the vehicle departs from |
| started_at | string | 255 | Fecha donde se inicio la ruta |
| fleet_sequence | string | 255 | Informacion de secuencia de rutas |
| login_url | string | 255 | Url de login para utilizar algo en especifico |
| tags | json [] |   | Vehicle characteristics, orders must have the same tags |
| driver | json |   | Informacion del conductor |
| driver.email | string | 255 | Driver email |
| driver.full_name | string | 255 | Driver name |
| driver.phone | string | 255 | Telefono del conductor |
| summary | json |   | Route information |
| summary.total_trips | number |   | Total trips |
| summary.total_orders | number |   | Total orders |
| summary.total_addresses | number |   | Total addresses |
| summary.total_distance | number |   | Total de distancia a recorrer |
| summary.total_time | number |   | Total de tiempo |
| trips | json [] |   | Conjunto de informacion de cada viaje |
| trips[0...].results[0...].deposit | boolean |   | Refers to whether it leaves or returns to the depot |
| trips[0...].results[0...].position | number |   | Position in the trip |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta_mode | number |   | Selects how to write the ETA in the complete route |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta | string | 255 | Estimated time of arrival (updated after each delivery) |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta_approved | string | 255 | Time at which the driver approves the route, ETA is recalculated |
| trips[0...].results[0...].eta_started | string | 255 | Time at which the driver starts the route, ETA is recalculated |
| stop | json |   | Stop location information |
| stop.code | string | 255 | Address code |
| stop.name | string | 255 | Address name |
| stop.client | string | 255 | Customer name |
| stop.address_type | string | 255 | Address type |
| stop.address | string | 255 | Address |
| stop.reference | string | 255 | Address reference |
| stop.city | string | 255 | Address city |
| stop.country | string | 255 | Address country |
| stop.lat | number |   | Address latitude |
| stop.lng | number |   | Address longitude |
| stop.postal_code | string | 255 | Address postal code |
| stop.service_time | string | 255 | Service time |
| stop.priority | number |   | Priority de la visita (Ej: Priority 2, 3 o 4, donde 2 es más prioritario que 3 y 4) |
| stop.skills | json |   | Address characteristics |
| stop.time_windows | json [] |   | Array of time windows for the visit to take place |
| stop.time_windows[0].start | string | 255 | Time window start time "hh:mm" |
| stop.time_windows[0].end | string | 255 | Time window end time "hh:mm" |
| orders | json [] |   | Set of orders |
| orders[0].idx | string | 255 | Indice de la entrega dependiente de ruta primaria |
| orders[0...].code | string | 255 | Order code |
| orders[0...].delivery_date | string | 255 | Delivery date |
| orders[0...].supplier_code | string | 255 | Supplier code |
| orders[0...].supplier_name | string | 255 | Nombre del proveedor |
| orders[0...].client_code | string | 255 | Customer code |
| orders[0...].client_name | string | 255 | Customer name |
| orders[0...].contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name |
| orders[0...].contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone |
| orders[0..].contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email |
| orders[0...].units | number |   | Number of units |
| orders[0...].units_1 | number |   | Unit of measure e.g.: Kg |
| orders[0...].units_2 | number |   | Unit of measure 2 e.g.: M3 |
| orders[0...].units_3 | number |   | Unit of measure 3 e.g.: Trays or Pallets |
| orders[0...].(custom_1-custom_11) | string | 255 | Custom field for description |
| orders[0...].(number_1-number_4) | string | 255 | Custom field for required value |
| items | json [] |   | Set of items or articles of the order |
| pickups | json [] |   | Set of orders to pick up |

```bash
curl --location 'structure example'
```

### Webhook Proof of Delivery

`POST`

endpoint to send webhook
This Webhook will be triggered when an address is closed, generating a Proof of Delivery (POD).

La información disponible en los links contenidos en la trama del webhook, por defecto, está accesible por un período de 48 horas a partir de su generación. Transcurrido ese tiempo, los links expiran y dejan de estar disponibles.

If you need to configure this service, please contact soporte@driv.in para que les solicitemos la información necesaria (endpoint y autenticación).

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| planned_date | string | 255 | Fecha planeada de acuerdo al plan de visita |
| description | string | 255 | Plan description |
| scenario_token | string | 255 | Scenario token |
| vehicle_code | string | 255 | Vehicle code |
| schema_code | string | 255 | Schema code used |
| schema_name | string | 255 | Schema name utilizado |
| fleet_name | string | 255 | Nombre del la flota utilizada |
| organization_name | string | 255 | Nombre de la organización |
| organization_alt_name | string | 255 | Nombre alternativo de la organización |
| supplier_code | string | 255 | Supplier code |
| employer_code | string | 255 | Employer code |
| employer_name | string | 255 | Employer name |
| trip_number | number |   | Trip number |
| odometer_start | number |   | Valor del odometro al inciar la entrega |
| odometer_end | number |   | Valor del odometro al finalizar la entrega |
| route_id | integer | 11 | Route identifier |
| route_code | string | 255 | Route code |
| route_is_approved | boolean |   | Route approved |
| route_is_started | boolean |   | Ruta inciada |
| route_is_finished | boolean |   | Ruta Finalizada |
| route_approved_at | string | 255 | Fecha de aprobacion de ruta en la aplicacion web |
| route_started_at | string | 255 | Fecha de inicio de ruta por el conductor |
| route_finished_at | string | 255 | Fecha de finalizacion de ruta por el conductor |
| driver_name | string | 255 | Driver name |
| driver_email | string | 255 | Driver email |
| driver_dni | string | 255 | Driver ID number |
| driver_license_number | string | 255 | Numero de Driver license |
| assistant_1_name | string | 255 | Driver assistant 1 |
| assistant_1_email | string | 255 | Driver assistant 1 email |
| address_name | string | 255 | Address name de entrega |
| address_code | string | 255 | Delivery address code |
| address_address_1 | string | 255 | Delivery address |
| address_customer_name | string | 255 | Customer name |
| address_lat | string | 255 | Address latitude de entrega |
| address_lng | string | 255 | Address longitude de entrega |
| address_postal_code | string | 255 | Delivery address postal code |
| address_country | string | 255 | Pais de la entrega |
| planned_service_time | number |   | Planned service time |
| eta | string | 255 | Estimated time of arrival (updated after each delivery) |
| eta_approved | string | 255 | Time at which the driver approves the route, ETA is recalculated |
| eta_started | string | 255 | Time at which the driver starts the route, ETA is recalculated |
| time_windows | json |   | Array of time windows for the visit to take place |
| time_windows.start | string | 255 | Time window start time "hh:mm" |
| time_windows.end | string | 255 | Time window end time "hh:mm" |
| tracked_arrival | string | 255 | Date and time when the location service detects the vehicle arrived at the address |
| tracked_leave | string | 255 | Date and time when the location service detects the vehicle left the address |
| tracked_service_time | number |   | Time at which the location service detects how long the service lasted |
| visit_arrival | string | 255 | Fecha y hora de la llegada a sitio |
| visit_leave | string | 255 | Fecha y hora de la ida del sitio |
| images | json [] | 255 | Imagenes de la entrega |
| signature | string | 255 | Firmas registradas en la aplicacion |
| pdf_pod | string | 255 | Pdf del producto entregado |
| tracking_url | string | 255 | Url de seguimiento del producto |
| comment | string | 255 | Delivery comments |
| revisit | boolean | 255 | Hace referencia a si necesita una revisita |
| custom_fields | json [] | 255 | Campos personalizados |
| custom_fields[0...].title | string | 255 | Titulo del campo personalizado |
| custom_fields[0...].value | string | 255 | Valor del campo personalizado |
| events | json [] |   | Visit events, e.g., when the visit was closed |
| notification_events | json [] |   | Notificaciones de eventos de la entrega |
| notification_events[0...].name | string | 255 | Nombre del evento de la entrega |
| notification_events[0...].code | string | 255 | Delivery event code |
| notification_events[0...].lat | number | 255 | Latitud donde se origino el evento de la entrega |
| notification_events[0...].lng | number | 255 | Longitud donde se origino el evento de la entrega |
| notification_events[0...].datetime | string | 255 | Fecha donde se origino el evento de la entrega |
| orders | json [] |   | Set of orders |
| orders[0...].code | string | 255 | Order code |
| orders[0...].alt_code | string | 255 | Alternative order code |
| orders[0...].delivery_date | string | 255 | Fecha maxima de entrega |
| orders[0...].description | string | 255 | Descripcion de orden |
| orders[0...].deploy_date | string | 255 | Date the plan was created |
| orders[0...].billing_date | string | 255 | Order billing date |
| orders[0...].address_type | string | 255 | Address type |
| orders[0...].pod_arrival | string | 255 | Fecha hora de la llegada del producto |
| orders[0...].pod_lat | number |   | Delivery proof latitude |
| orders[0...].pod_lng | number |   | Delivery proof longitude |
| orders[0...].status | string | 255 | Order status: (pending/approved/partial/rejected) |
| orders[0...].status_code | string | 255 | Order status code |
| orders[0...].load_status | string | 255 | Load status code (default is "pending") |
| orders[0...].reason | string | 255 | Motivo de la orden |
| orders[0...].reason_code | string | 255 | Reason code de la orden |
| orders[0...].images | json[] |   | Imagen de entrega de la orden |
| orders[0...].supplier_code | string | 255 | Order supplier code |
| orders[0...].supplier_name | string | 255 | Nombre del proveedor la orden |
| orders[0...].client_code | string | 255 | Customer code la orden |
| orders[0...].client_name | string | 255 | Customer name la orden |
| orders[0...].order_type | string | 255 | Order type |
| orders[0...].order_type_name | string | 255 | Nombre de tipo de orden |
| orders[0...].category | string | 255 | Order category (delivery o pickup) |
| orders[0...].contact_name | string | 255 | Contact name de la orden |
| orders[0...].contact_phone | string | 255 | Contact phone de la orden |
| orders[0...].contact_email | string | 255 | Contact email de la orden |
| orders[0...].units_1 | number |   | Capacidad en Unidad de medida ej: en kg |
| orders[0...].units_2 | number |   | Capacidad en Unidad de medida ej: en M3 |
| orders[0...].units_3 | number |   | Capacidad en Unidad de medida ej: en bandejas o pallets |
| orders[0...].cusom_1 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: invoice type |
| orders[0...].cusom_2 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: payment condition |
| orders[0...].cusom_3 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: planned monetary value |
| orders[0...].cusom_4 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: actual monetary value |
| orders[0...].cusom_5 | string | 255 | Field used for collection: indicates if there was a change in payment methods |
| orders[0...].(custom_6-custom_11) | string | 255 | Field for additional information de la orden |
| orders[0...].(number_1-number_4) | string | 255 | Custom field for required value |
| documents_with_names | json [] |   | Set of documents with names |
| orders[0...].is_otd | boolean |   | Hace referencia si se entrego en la ventana horaria |
| orders[0...].created_at | string | 255 | Fecha en la que se creo la orden |
| items | json [] |   | Set of order items |
| items[0...].code | string | 255 | Item code |
| items[0...].description | string | 255 | Item description |
| items[0...].units | number |   | Item unit quantity |
| items[0...].units_1 | number |   | Capacidad en Unit of measure 1 Ej: en Kg (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| items[0...].units_2 | number |   | Capacidad en Unit of measure 2 Ej: en M3 (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| items[0...].units_3 | number |   | Capacidad en Unit of measure 3 en Ej: Bandejas o Pallets (este campo tiene prioridad sobre el mismo definido a nivel de la orden) |
| items[0...].loaded_units | number |   | Unidades en la carga |
| items[0...].delivered_units | number |   | Delivered units |
| items[0...].requested_units | number |   | Unidades solicitadas |
| items[0...].status | string | 255 | Item status |
| items[0...].status_code | string | 255 | Item status code |
| items[0...].reason | string | 255 | Motivo del item |
| items[0...].reason_code | string | 255 | Reason code del item |
| pickups | json [] |   | Conjunto de items a retirar |

Tipos de notificaciones de eventos de la entrega

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| trip_approved | Viaje aprobado, se habilita cuando se aprueba el viaje o ruta |
| start_route | Ruta del viaje iniciada, se habilita cuando el conductor inicia el viaje a la direccion |
| on_its_way | En camino, se habilita cuando este cerca del punto a entrega |
| close_address | Address cerrada, se habilita cuando el conductor cierra la direccion |

### Webhook Events

`POST`

endpoint to send webhook
This Webhook will be triggered when an event occurs.

If you need to configure this service, please contact soporte@driv.in para que les solicitemos la información necesaria (endpoint y autenticación)

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| lat | number |   | Latitud donde ocurrio el evento |
| lng | number |   | Longitud donde ocurrio el evento |
| datetime | string | 255 | Fecha y hora del evento |
| vehicle_code | string | 255 | Vehicle code |
| route_id | number |   | Route identifier |
| route_id | string | 255 | Route code |
| deploy_date | string | 255 | Fecha de carga de la ruta |
| supplier_code | string | 255 | Supplier code |
| event_type_name | string | 255 | Tipo de evento el cual disparo el webhook, este tiene que ser previamente solicitado para configurar el servicio para este tipo de evento |
| event_type_code | string | 255 | Event type code |
| trip_number | json [] |   | Trip number |
| driver | json |   | Informacion del conductor |
| driver.email | string | 255 | Driver email |
| driver.full_name | string | 255 | Driver name |
| driver.phone | string | 255 | Telefono del conductor |
| user | json |   | Informacion del usuario |
| orders | json[] |   | Informacion de la orden en la cual ocurrio el evento |
| address_code | string | 255 | Address code where the event originated |

**Example Request**

structure example

```bash
curl --location 'structure example'
```

_200 OK_

**Example Response**

**Body**

```json
{
  "lat": -33.4821072,
  "lng": 70.6245978,
  "datetime": "2022-03-01T12:33:40.000Z",
  "vehicle_code": "ABC460",
  "scenario_token": "9d075ea6-473a-4125-a471-8ad46bda4d0f",
  "route_id": 23561289,
  "route_code": null,

  "supplier_name": null,
  "event_type_name": "Nombre del tipo de evento",

  "trip_number": [
    1
  ],
  "driver": {
    "email": "conductor@email.com",
    "full_name": "Nombres y Apellidos",
    "phone": "999999999"
```

### Webhook Addresses

`POST`

endpoint to send webhook
This Webhook will be triggered when an address editing event occurs.

If you need to configure this service, please contact soporte@driv.in para que les solicitemos la información necesaria (endpoint y autenticación)

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| address1 | string | 255 | Physical address, e.g., street and number |
| address2 | string | 255 | Reference to add to the address (Office, Apartment, etc.) |
| address_name | string | 255 | Address name |
| address_code | string | 255 | Código de la dirección |
| state | string | 255 | Region or State of the address (depends on the country) |
| city | string | 255 | Municipality or City of the address (depends on the country) |
| county | string | 255 | Condado o Provincia |
| country | string | 255 | Address country |
| client_name | string | 255 | Customer name |
| client_code | string | 255 | Customer code |
| lat | number |   | Latitud de la dirección |
| lng | number |   | Longitud de la dirección |
| description | string | 255 | Descripción de la dirección |
| tag | string | 255 | Array of characteristics |

**Example Request**

structure example

```bash
curl --location 'structure example'
```

_200 OK_

**Example Response**

**Body**

```json
{
  "address1": "Av. Entre Ríos 1633",
  "address2": "Departamento 5C",
  "address_name": "Pedro Perez",

  "city": "Parque Patricios",
  "county": "CABA",
  "country": "Argentina",
  "client_name": "Pedro Perez",
  "client_code": "10031774",
  "lat": -34.62756410586803,
  "lng": -58.391438031678945,

}
```

### Cost Schema

```http
POST https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/cost_schemas
```

With this method you can create cost schemas

Below is the description of the data obtained.

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cost_schema | json |   | número de folio |
| name | string | 255 | nombre del esquema de costo |
| cost_schema_type | string | 255 | tipo de esquema de costo |
| multi_employer | boolean |   | empleador múltiple (si=true, no=false) |
| multi_supplier | boolean |   | proveedor múltiple (si=true, no=false) |
| cost_concepts | array |   | concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].name | string | 255 | nombre del concepto de costos |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost_concept_type_id | number |   | id del tipo de concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost | number |   | Driver name |
| cost_concepts[0...].start_cost | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].baseline_cost | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].days | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].supplier_name | string | 255 | nombre del empleador del concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].employer_name | string | 255 | nombre del empleador del concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].is_max | boolean |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].min_range | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].max_range | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost_unit_id | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_1 | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_2 | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_3 | number |   |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_function | string- or number?= | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].output_tag | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].output_tag2 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].output_tag3 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].assistant_1 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].assistant_1assistant_2 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].assistant_3 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost_allocation_tags | array |   | tags de asignación de costos |
| cost_allocation_tags[0...].name | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].vehicle_tags | array |   | tags de vehículos |
| vehicle_tags[0...].name | string | 255 |   |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Body**

raw (json)

```json
{
    "cost_schema": {
        "name": "03-12-24",
        "cost_schema_type": "cost",
        "multi_employer": false,
        "multi_supplier": false,
        "cost_concepts": [
            {
                "name": "Viajes",
                "cost_concept_type_id": 21,
                "cost": 1200349,
                "start_cost": 0,
                "baseline_cost": 0,
                "days": null,
                "supplier_name": null,
                "employer_name": "prueba",
                "is_max": false,
                "min_range": 1,
                "max_range": 10,
                "cost_unit_id": null,
                "factor": null,
                "factor_1": null,
                "factor_2": null,
                "factor_3": null,
                "factor_function": null,
                "output_tag": null,
                "output_tag2": "CLP",
                "output_tag3": "Empresa Transporte",
                "assistant_1": null,
                "assistant_2": null,
                "assistant_3": null,
                "cost_allocation_tags": [
                    {
                        "name": "C13082"
                    }
                ],
                "vehicle_tags": [
                    {
                        "name": "C16"
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

### Cost Schema

```http
GET https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/cost_schemas
```

With this method you can create cost schemas

Below is the description of the data obtained.

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cost_schema | json |   | número de folio |
| name | string | 255 | nombre del esquema de costo |
| cost_schema_type | string | 255 | tipo de esquema de costo |
| multi_employer | boolean |   | empleador múltiple (si=true, no=false) |
| multi_supplier | boolean |   | proveedor múltiple (si=true, no=false) |
| cost_concepts | array |   | concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].name | string | 255 | nombre del concepto de costos |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost_concept_type_id | number | 255 | id del tipo de concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost | number | 255 | Driver name |
| cost_concepts[0...].start_cost | number | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].baseline_cost | number | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].days | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].supplier_name | string | 255 | nombre del empleador del concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].employer_name | string | 255 | nombre del empleador del concepto de costo |
| cost_concepts[0...].is_max | boolean | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].min_range | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].max_range | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost_unit_id | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_1 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_2 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_3 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].factor_function | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].output_tag | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].output_tag2 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].output_tag3 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].assistant_1 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].assistant_1assistant_2 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].assistant_3 | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].cost_allocation_tags | array |   |   |
| cost_allocation_tags[0...].name | string | 255 |   |
| cost_concepts[0...].vehicle_tags | array | 255 |   |
| vehicle_tags[0...].name | string | 255 |   |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Body**

raw (json)

```json
{
    "cost_schema": {
        "name": "03-12-24",
        "cost_schema_type": "cost",
        "multi_employer": false,
        "multi_supplier": false,
        "cost_concepts": [
            {
                "name": "Viajes",
                "cost_concept_type_id": 21,
                "cost": 1200349,
                "start_cost": 0,
                "baseline_cost": 0,
                "days": null,

                "employer_name": "prueba",
                "is_max": false,
                "min_range": 1,
                "max_range": 10,
                "cost_unit_id": null,
                "factor": null,
                "factor_1": null,
                "factor_2": null,
                "factor_3": null,
                "factor_function": null,
                "output_tag": null,
                "output_tag2": "CLP",
```

**Example Request**

_200 OK_

```bash
curl --location --request POST 'https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/cost_schemas' \
--header 'X-API-Key: {{api_key}}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

Business Partners
For now this API can only be used to create business partners, not to update them.

### Create Business Partner

```http
POST https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/business_partners
```

With this API you can create a partner of type: customer, supplier, employer.

| Fields | Type | Size | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| business_partner | Json |   |   |
| code | string required | 255 | Code that identifies the partner |
| name | string | 255 | nombre que identifica al socio |
| type | string required | 255 | tipo de socio (supplier, customer, employer) |
| billing_information | Json |   | Billing information |
| business_name | string | 255 | nombre del negocio |
| secondary_name | string | 255 | nombre secundario |
| business_activity | string | 255 | rubro del negocio |
| address | string | 255 | dirección |
| city | string | 255 | ciudad |
| state | string | 255 | estado/region |
| phone | string | 255 | telefono del contacto |
| email | string | 255 | email del contacto |
| payment_option | string | 255 | opcion de pago |
| contact | Json |   |   |
| name | string | 255 | nombre del contacto |
| phone | string | 255 | teléfono de contacto |
| email | string | 255 | email de contacto |

**Headers**

- `X-API-Key`: {{api_key}}
- `Content-Type`: application/json

**Body (raw)**

```json
{
    "business_partner": {
            "code": "5560000002",
            "name": "Prueba SL",
            "type": null,
            "billing_information": {
                "business_name": "Client test",
                "secondary_name": "",
                "business_activity": "",
                "address": "La Oración 43",
                "city": "Santiago",
                "state": null,
                "phone": null,
                "email": null,
                "payment_option": null
            },
            "contact": {
                    "name": "nombre de prueba",
                    "phone": "1212121",
                    "email": "prueba@correo.com"
                }
        }
}
```

**Example Request**

Ejemplo 1

```bash
curl --location 'https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/business_partners' \
--header 'X-API-Key: {{api_key}}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "business_partner": {
            "code": "5560000002",
            "name": "Prueba SL",
            "type": "customer",
            "billing_information": {
                "business_name": "Client test",
                "secondary_name": "",
                "business_activity": "",
                "address": "La Oración 43",
                "city": "Santiago",
                "state": null,
                "phone": null,
                "email": null,
                "payment_option": null
            },
            "contact": {
                    "name": "nombre de prueba",
                    "phone": "1212121",
                    "email": "prueba@correo.com"
                }
        }
}
'
```

```json
}
```

Trip Settlement
General Description
This API allows confirming the receipt of orders associated with a specific trip and also managing trip settlement in the Drivin system.

Endpoint
POST https://external.driv.in/api/external/v2/trips/receive

Authentication
The API uses authentication via API Key that must be included in the request headers.

Headers Requeridos

| Header | Valor | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| X-API-Key | xxxxxxxxxxxxxx-xxx | API key for authentication |
| Content-Type | application/json | Formato de los datos enviados |

Cuerpo de la Solicitud (Request Body)
El cuerpo de la solicitud debe ser un objeto JSON con la siguiente estructura:

```json
{
    "trip_code": "11",
    "orders": [
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C7",
            "load_status": "received"
        }
    ]
}
```

Parameters

| Parámetro | Type | Description | Requerido |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| trip_code | string | Código identificador del viaje | Sí |
| orders | array | Lista de órdenes a marcar como recibidas | Sí |
| orders[].code | string | Código identificador de la orden | No |
| orders[].load_status | string | Load status (debe ser "received" para confirmar recepción) | No |

Valores posibles para load_status

| Valor | Descripción |
| --- | --- |
| received | La orden ha sido recibida correctamente |
| missing | La orden está extraviada y requiere gestión especial |

Respuesta Esperada
La API debería devolver un código de estado HTTP 200 OK si la operación es exitosa, junto con un objeto JSON que contiene información sobre el resultado de la operación.

Ejemplo de Uso
Solicitud cURL
Plain Text
bash
curl --location 'https://xxxxx.com/api/external/v2/trips/receive' \
--header 'X-API-Key: xxxxxxxxx-xxxx' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "trip_code": "11",
    "orders": [

```json
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C7",
            "load_status": "received"
        }
```

    ]
}'
Settlement Behaviors
Settlement with trip_code Only
Si se envía únicamente el trip_code sin incluir el array de orders (o con un array vacío), el sistema liquidará automáticamente todas las órdenes del viaje, tanto aprobadas como rechazadas, cambiando su estado a "liquidado".
En el caso específico de viajes donde todos los pedidos o órdenes han sido rechazados, basta con enviar el trip_code sin las órdenes internas. El viaje se liquidará automáticamente cambiando el estado de las órdenes rechazadas a liquidadas.

```json
{
    "trip_code": "22",
    "orders": []
}
```

Settlement with Specific Orders
Si se incluyen órdenes específicas en la solicitud, estas serán marcadas con el estado indicado en load_status. Por convención y buena práctica, es importante enviar siempre las órdenes aprobadas con load_status: "received".

```json
{
    "trip_code": "11",
    "orders": [
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C7",
            "load_status": "received"
        },
        {
            "code": "TEST6YMZQ9D8",
            "load_status": "missing"
        }
    ]
}
```

Important note: Orders marked as "missing" will remain in this state in the system so they can be analyzed or managed individually later.

Respuesta Esperada
La API debería devolver un código de estado HTTP 200 OK si la operación es exitosa, junto con un objeto JSON que contiene información sobre el resultado de la operación.

Ejemplo de Uso
cURL Request for Complete Settlement

```json
curl --location 'https://xxxxx.com/api/external/v2/trips/receive' \
--header 'X-API-Key: xxxxxxxxx-xxxx' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "trip_code": "11",
    "orders": []
}'
```

cURL Request for Settlement with Specific Orders

```json
curl --location 'https://xxxxx.com/api/external/v2/trips/receive' \
--header 'X-API-Key: xxxxxxxxx-xxxx' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "trip_code": "11",
    "orders": [
        {
            "code": "TEST5XKNR3C7",
            "load_status": "received"
        },
        {
            "code": "TEST6YMZQ9D8",
            "load_status": "missing"
        }
    ]
}'
```

Posibles Respuestas
Éxito al Liquidar un Viaje (200 OK)
When the trip is settled successfully:

```json
{
    "status": "Success",
    "message": "El viaje ha sido liquidado satisfactoriamente.",
    "data": {
        "trip_code": "12",
        "orders_received": 1
    }
}
```

Invalid API Key Error (401 Unauthorized)
When the API key is invalid or simply does not exist:

```json
{
    "status": "error",
    "response": {
        "description": "Invalid API key"
    }
}
```

Error de Viaje No Encontrado (404 Not Found)
When the trip code does not exist for that organization or is not valid:

```json
{
    "status": "Error",
    "response": {
        "description": "Trip not found. Please verify the information sent."
    }
}
```

Error de Viaje No Finalizado (400 Bad Request)
Cuando el viaje ha sido aprobado e iniciado, y se intenta liquidar sin haber finalizado:

```json
{
    "status": "Error",
    "response": "El viaje no ha sido finalizado. Favor de finalizar antes de liquidar."
}
```

Error de Viaje Ya Liquidado (400 Bad Request)
Cuando se intenta liquidar un viaje que ya ha sido liquidado previamente:

```json
{
    "status": "Error",
    "response": "El viaje ya ha sido liquidado."
}
```

Business Conditions and Rules (Version 1.0)
Trip validation: The trip_code must correspond to an active trip in the system. If it does not exist, an error will be returned indicating the trip was not found.

Order status: Only orders with "pending" status can be marked as "received".

Trip lifecycle: A trip must be finished before it can be settled. If you try to settle a trip that has not yet finished, an error will be returned.

Single settlement: A trip can only be settled once. If you try to settle a trip that has already been settled, a specific error will be returned.

Receipt confirmation: Once an order is marked as "received", it cannot return to a previous state.

Lost orders: Orders marked as "missing" will remain in this state for special management.

Additional Notes and Future Evolution
Current validation: In version 1.0 of this API, the existence of orders sent in the request is not being validated. However, as best practice and preparation for future versions, it is important to always send the correct orders.

Future changes: In upcoming versions, validation will be implemented to verify that orders actually belong to the indicated trip.

LimaGas Client: For this specific client, rejected orders will not be considered in future validation.
